findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Observed several ceiling tiles throughout the store are either missing or showing signs of water damage. Ensure that the missing or damaged ceiling tiles are replaced by the next routine inspection.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present
findings.comment: Observed dead insects found in back storage room and bathroom (both men and women's). Ensure dead insects are removed in timely manner to prevent attraction from other insects. Reference 6-501.112.

findings.title: Wholesome, sound condition
findings.comment: Observed several (4+) dented cans in the canned goods aisle. Dented cans were removed from the aisle to be returned to distributor. Cans dented on the vertical and horizontal seams are not in sound condition. Cans should be routinely inspected for dents and any cans dented on the vertical or horizontal seam should be removed from the sales floor.750-100 Food shall be in sound condition, free from spoilage, filth, and other contamination and shall be safe for human consumption.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
Observed the sliding door ice cream chest freezer to have a heavy accumulation of frost/ice build up. Defrost and maintain freezer to provide a smooth, cleanable surface.
750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.750-600 Non-food contact surfaces shall be smooth and easily cleanable

findings.title: Food protection during storage, prepartion, display, service, transportation
findings.comment:
Observed a case of large bags of cereal  stored on the display floor in food section of store. (Corrected) Manager stocked the cereal and moved it  off the floor.
750-130(b) Food shall be stored at least 6 inches off the floor.  Properly store and protect food.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
Gasket on the Prairie Farms cooler in back is not on straight and lined up. Repair the gasket on cooler-make it smooth and easily cleanable for the surface area.
750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
The inside of the lid on the Prairie Farms milk cooler in the back room is coming apart.
750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
There is a build-up of ice inside the bottom of the Prairie Farms milk cooler in the back room.
750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.
Clean the inside of the cooler.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
There was debris on the floor around the exterior door in the back supply room and under and in back of the Prairie Farms milk cooler in the back supply room.
750-1220 Floors shall be kept clean. 
Clean the floor.
